answer: Proof of Stake establishes Sybil resistance by requiring collateral locked within an ocean of capital to gain network influence. An attacker aiming to spawn a grove of fraudulent identities must acquire a proportional stake for each, incurring a capital cost that scales linearly. If a ravenous node attempts to validate false data, the underlying protocol slashes its locked assets, rendering the cost of identity fabrication economically irrational compared to the guaranteed loss of principal.
